# uptimecheck_status_pages (Data Source)

The workspace's public status pages.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimecheck_status_pages" "all" {}

output "status_page_urls" {
  value = [for p in data.uptimecheck_status_pages.all.items : p.url]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) Every entry in the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The status page's id (sp_…).
- `language` (String) The language visitors see the page in.
- `project_id` (String) The project (client) it belongs to, if any.
- `published` (Boolean) false when the page is offline.
- `slug` (String) The address after /s/.
- `title` (String) The page's heading.
- `url` (String) The public address.
